BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, among the curses of the covenant: the Lord will give a trembling heart and failing of eyes and sorrow of mind, and the soul shall pine away. It is the slow wasting of a people who have turned away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse shows that disobedience wastes a people from the inside, long before any enemy arrives.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
